predictions.selection_reason: observable input/state -> exact operation -> security-sensitive effect

top_sast_rules.description: An access-control policy is missing or incorrectly enforced for a protected resource.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-284 access-control authorization permission acl role owner ownership privilege protected-resource protected-endpoint allow deny
top_sast_rules.remediation: Require explicit server-side authorization before protected operations.

top_sast_rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-863 incorrect-authorization authorization-check permission-check role-check ownership-check acl-check access-decision bypass
top_sast_rules.remediation: Evaluate authorization from trusted server-side identity and policy state.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
top_sast_rules.description: Directly sending file data in an outbound network request can indicate unauthorized information disclosure.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Find code that may expose sensitive information in error messages, logs, or responses
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper access control checks. Use role-based or attribute-based authorization and validate permissions consistently.

top_sast_rules.description: Legacy access-control category for failures in permissions, privileges, or authorization enforcement.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-264 permissions privileges access-control authorization acl role privilege owner permission enforcement
top_sast_rules.remediation: Enforce trusted authorization, role, ownership, and permission checks.

top_sast_rules.description: Hard-coding credentials in source code may enable an attacker to gain unauthorized access.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-321. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.
